description: Shell script for testing cloning repositories and storing files in Mock LFS, including setup, file creation, and verification steps.

methods.name: test_file_is_not_in_mock_lfs
methods.description: Verifies that a file is not stored in Mock LFS by comparing content.

methods.name: test_file_is_in_mock_lfs
methods.description: Verifies that a file and its associated storage are correctly stored in Mock LFS.

methods.name: test_file_is_deleted_in_mock_lfs
methods.description: Verifies that a file has been deleted from the repository but remains in Mock LFS storage.

methods.name: test_file_count_in_dir
methods.description: Counts files in a directory and compares with expected count.
